name: Buj (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Buj: a red and blue shield with a white bend and stars, with a helm, a crest and red, yellow and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Buj arms with helm, crest and mantling
